source_name: COMPLIANCE SUMMIT (Akademie C. H. Beck)
why_relevant: Annual CZ compliance conference (2nd edition 12 March 2026) covering AML, corporate criminal liability, AI & cybersecurity. Agenda shows which compliance obligations legal practitioners expect to dominate the coming year; organiser is a legal publisher close to regulators.

source_name: Časopis Bankovnictví – Eventy (banking trade magazine event listings)
why_relevant: Trade-press event calendar for the CZ banking sector; both announces and reports on conferences, giving agenda content plus post-event summaries when programmes are not archived.

source_name: IT ve finančnictví (konference.cz) – banking IT conference
why_relevant: Vendor-heavy IT-in-finance conference; agenda reveals which regulatory-driven IT programmes (DORA ICT risk, reporting, instant payments) CZ banks are procuring for — vendor sessions typically advertise compliance deadlines to sell readiness.

source_name: Banking Innovation Forum & Expo (Cubex Centrum Praha)
why_relevant: Long-running CZ banking innovation event bringing together bank leaders, risk specialists and payment innovation vendors; venue and organiser pages list agendas that surface regulatory-driven themes early.

source_name: Akce Deloitte (Deloitte CZ event portal) + Deloitte Financial Markets Regulatory Outlook webinars
why_relevant: Big-4 event portal; regulatory outlook webinars and DORA/PSD3 briefings name obligations and effective dates that advisers expect CZ institutions to hit. Advisory marketing is an early, deadline-explicit signal.

source_name: PwC ČR – Budoucnost regulatorního výkaznictví / DORA topic pages
why_relevant: Vendor/advisory readiness marketing that states concrete CZ-relevant reporting milestones (e.g. IReF regulation adoption expected Jan 2026, first IReF report planned Jan 2027) — deadline claims made to sell preparation, often ahead of ČNB communication.

source_name: KPMG ČR / EY ČR – DORA and financial-regulation service & event pages
why_relevant: Parallel Big-4 readiness channel for CZ; useful as corroboration when a deadline claim appears in only one adviser's material. EY CZ maintains a Czech-language DORA page.

source_name: epravo.cz – monthly 'Novinky z české a evropské regulace finančních institucí'
why_relevant: Law-firm-authored monthly regulatory roundup published on the main CZ legal portal. Not a regulator source, but it consolidates CZ+EU obligations with dates (e.g. EBA ESG risk guidelines applying from Jan 2026) and is the practitioner channel institutions actually read.

source_name: Kopecný & Partners – commentary on ČNB supervision report / regulatory themes
why_relevant: CZ law-firm blog translating the ČNB supervision report into 'main regulatory themes for financial institutions' — an indirect read of supervisory priorities that firms are marketing readiness against (DORA, MiCA, AML/CFT, consumer protection, supervisory digitalisation).

source_name: ČNB – konference, workshopy a semináře
why_relevant: Boundary case for this cell: the regulator's own event page. Mostly economic research, but it identifies which external events ČNB staff host or speak at, and the ČNB Congress Centre is the venue for industry events such as FinTech Roadmap — a useful bridge between the indirect-event channel and official sources.

source_name: Sonet blog – CARDFORUM conference reports (vendor post-event coverage)
why_relevant: CZ payments vendor publishing write-ups of CARDFORUM editions in CS and EN. Where the conference itself publishes no online agenda, vendor recaps are the only accessible record of which regulatory/technical topics were discussed.

source_name: Ministerstvo financí ČR – konference a semináře (vzdělávání)
why_relevant: MF ČR is the transposing ministry for payments/AML legislation; its event and training listings can flag transposition workshops and stakeholder seminars ahead of formal consultation, complementing ČNB-side sources.

source_name: paytech.events – CardForum listing (international event aggregator)
why_relevant: English-language aggregator carrying dates, venue, pricing and agenda pointers for CZ payment events (CardForum Seč, 25–27 May 2026). Useful as an English discovery surface and for structured event metadata.

source_name: ČNB – Seznamy a evidence (hub for all supervisory lists and registers)
why_relevant: Master index page of every list/register the ČNB is legally obliged to publish (JERRS, prospectus registers, other lists, open data, WS JERRS). Single crawl entry point that snowballs into all register-type sources for CZ banking and payments.

source_name: JERRS – Seznamy regulovaných a registrovaných subjektů finančního trhu (application)
why_relevant: The authoritative register of every licensed, registered, notified or listed financial-market entity in CZ – banks, payment institutions, e-money institutions, small-scale providers, CASPs, intermediaries. Each entity record is itself a pointer to a further actor whose own compliance/investor pages become sources.

source_name: WS JERRS – ČNB register web services (SOAP/XML)
why_relevant: Machine-readable, officially sanctioned access to JERRS since 1.7.2019. Three services: subject detail (identification, seat, authorisation dates, permitted activities, relations), subject list by role, and list of representatives. The correct long-term ingestion channel instead of scraping.

source_name: ČNB Otevřená data (open data downloads from JERRS, CSV + JSON schema)
why_relevant: Seven statutory open datasets published under nařízení vlády 425/2016 Sb.: banks and foreign bank branches, exchange offices (směnárny), non-bank consumer-credit providers, independent and tied credit intermediaries, tied representatives, foreign credit intermediaries. Direct stable CSV endpoints with documented JSON schemas – the cheapest reliable structured feed of regulated CZ actors.

source_name: Národní katalog otevřených dat (NKOD) – ČNB datasets
why_relevant: The national open-data catalogue carries ČNB dataset records with DCAT metadata (distribution URLs, update frequency 'daily', contact seznamy.subjektu@cnb.cz). Useful for discovering ČNB datasets we did not know existed and for machine-readable freshness metadata.

source_name: ČNB ABOK – application of final decisions in proceedings started after 1.1.2009
why_relevant: The searchable database behind the enforcement publication duty: individual sanction decisions (fines, remedial measures, licence withdrawals) against banks, payment institutions, e-money institutions, exchange offices and intermediaries from 2009 onward. Primary evidence for enforcement-trend and compliance-pressure analysis.

source_name: ČNB decision PDF repository (export/sites/cnb .galleries/prilohy)
why_relevant: Full-text PDFs of individual ČNB decisions are served from a predictable static path (e.g. S-Sp-2020_00436_CNB_573.pdf). Allows full-text extraction of reasoning, legal grounds and fine amounts rather than just a decision index line.

source_name: ČNB – Upozornění na aktivity (warnings on unauthorised firms / entities without licence)
why_relevant: Running list of platforms and entities the ČNB flags as offering financial-market services in CZ without authorisation. The negative counterpart of the register: shows enforcement attention, fraud typologies and unlicensed payment/crypto activity in near real time.

source_name: ČNB – Informace pro veřejnost k oprávnění osob poskytovat služby na finančním trhu
why_relevant: Explains how to verify an entity's authorisation and which register/role names correspond to which licence type – the semantic key needed to interpret JERRS role codes correctly when building an actor map.

source_name: ČNB – Povolovací a schvalovací řízení: poskytovatelé platebních služeb a vydavatelé elektronických peněz
why_relevant: Describes the licensing pipeline and entry into the register for payment service providers and e-money issuers, including application requirements and processing. Explains what precedes a new register entry and gives leading indicators of market entry.

source_name: ČNB – Seznamy institucí pro potřeby měnové a finanční statistiky (MFI list etc.)
why_relevant: A second, statistics-side register family (Seznam měnových finančních institucí / MFI, investment funds, other financial intermediaries) maintained under ECB statistical rules. Different population and different identifiers from JERRS – useful for cross-walking and for catching entities not in the supervisory lists.

source_name: ČNB – Ostatní seznamy (other statutory lists: covered bonds, OTC counterparties, payment system participants, comparison-site operators)
why_relevant: Holds several payments-relevant lists that are NOT inside JERRS: participants of CZ and foreign payment systems, participants of settlement systems, operators of comparison websites under §202 zákona o platebním styku, limited electronic-communication-network activity notifications, covered bond issuers, and a list of financial servers/agencies. Mostly PDF, so it needs its own parser.

source_name: ČNB – Adresář, seznamy a registry platebního styku (bank codes, IBAN, payment directories)
why_relevant: The payments-infrastructure register family: bank identification codes, account/IBAN structure, CERTIS participant and contact registers. Identifier backbone for mapping any payments actor to its clearing identity.
